results.title: Postpone panchayat, municipal elections to April-May next year: Ladakh group
results.content: “We suspect that this government is up to some mischief. We saw ‘vote chori’ in West Bengal, Bihar, Haryana, Maharashtra etc. In entire India 13 crore voters were dropped from the voter list.
